title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Mathangi asks Kanmani to lie about Anbu injuring her hand. Meanwhile, Anbu gives Kanmani a bouquet in front of the counsellors and pleads with her to forgive him.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Paraman regrets misunderstanding Ilamathi and opens up to his friend. Meanwhile, Ganthimathi is moved upon learning that Ilamathi borrowed money for her surgery.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Shanmugam leaves his job, unwilling to work for Karna after learning the truth. Karna receives Prabhakaran's court notice to appear in Parvathy's case investigation.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: Azhagar vows to protect his family's honour after learning of Poongodi's plan. Poongodi's plans take an unexpected turn when Pandian abducts her from Selvi's home.

title: Sindhu Bairavi
description: Bairavi finds her photos at Sanjay's house, discovering his secret love. She confronts him for creating a rift with Arumugam, realising Arumugam was right.

title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: After receiving assurance from Aneesh, Cheran leaves Chandayatha with her parents. Later, his brother's playful teasing about her pregnancy leaves Cheran puzzled.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Rekha's father persuades Sathya to manage his business, secretly planning to make them stay home permanently. Under Devika's pressure, Manoj registers his marriage to Kanaga.
